families.name: Moon Bronze adjustable bed
families.description: The Moon Bronze adjustable bed combines comfort and understated style. It features a pocket spring base without zones and tall smoked ash legs that add lightness and make cleaning easier. The bed frame is made from durable wood and can be complemented with optional toppers and headboards to suit your needs.

families.name: Moon Gold Adjustable Bed
families.description: The adjustable upper section lets you change the position of the Moon Gold bed for sitting or resting. The range includes beige and black upholstery with several widths to suit the room. Compare the dimensions and controls of the selected model, and check which components are included before choosing a matching topper or headboard.

families.name: Moon Silver adjustable bed
families.description: Choose a Moon Silver adjustable bed in the width that fits your room and sleeping arrangement. The grey upholstery keeps the finish consistent across the range, while product dimensions and construction details are shown for each model. Check the selected bed's controls, overall height and included components before arranging delivery or adding a topper and headboard.

families.name: Dove
families.description: Choose a Dove armchair to add a separate seat beside a sofa or in a reading corner. The range includes beige and brown colour options, with fabric, foam and wood recorded in the product details. Compare the exact chair's dimensions with the space available, allowing room to sit down and move around it.

families.name: Eagle Fixed Armchair
families.description: The Eagle armchair features a natural wood frame combined with fabric or faux leather upholstery. Its minimalist design suits various interiors, offering a comfortable and practical seating option for everyday use.

families.name: Swan
families.description: A Swan armchair creates a separate place to sit in the living room or bedroom. The range uses fabric, foam and wood, with beige and brown tones across the available options. Compare the photographs and measurements of the selected chair to choose the finish and position that suit the room.

families.name: Voyage
families.description: The Voyage fixed armchair offers a comfortable and inviting seat with a solid wood and plywood frame. It features soft foam and feather cushioning and removable cotton upholstery in natural white or sage green. Its simple, Scandinavian design complements a range of interiors.

families.name: Merida
families.description: The Merida bar stool combines a natural oak frame with a light fabric seat for a simple and timeless look. Its sturdy construction and minimalist design make it suitable for various dining and bar settings.

families.name: Casa
families.description: The Casa bed frame features a padded high headboard for comfortable support when reading or relaxing. Its low-profile frame and beige fabric create a harmonious and warm bedroom atmosphere. Made from durable wood and easy-care breathable fabric.

families.name: Moonlit
families.description: The Moonlit bed frame brings soft elegance and a calm atmosphere to the bedroom. Its durable structure supports restful sleep, while the high upholstered headboard provides comfortable support for sitting or relaxing. The beige bouclé fabric is easy to maintain and complements natural, understated interiors.

families.name: Aava
families.description: The Aava chaise sofa combines durable fabric upholstery with natural oak legs for a warm and modern look. Its generous dimensions provide ample space for everyday relaxation. The reversible chaise side allows easy adaptation to different room layouts.

families.name: Joy
families.description: The Joy family presents chaise sofas with a streamlined look suited to modern seating areas. Each piece is defined by its left orientation and white finish, creating a calm, coordinated presence in the room. This chaise sofa measures 246 × 155 × 75 cm and is specified in Fabric, Metal, Plywood, Polyester. Its layout pairs a chaiselongue with a two-seater section and armrest, offering a practical shape for lounging and everyday use.

families.name: Lugo
families.description: The Lugo 3-seater chaise sofa combines a modern design with practical comfort. It features a spacious chaise section on the left or right side and is upholstered in easy-care, structured fabric. The sofa has a solid frame with soft foam cushions for everyday use.

families.name: Sparkle
families.description: The Sparkle family brings a chaise sofa format in a roomy 242 × 153 × 71 cm size, designed in left- and right-facing options to suit different room layouts. Each piece is finished in one of three colours: Beige, Brown, or Green. All models are specified with Comfort foam and use Fabric, Foam, Metal, and Plywood. The collection gives a straightforward choice of handedness and colour while keeping the overall look and sizing consistent across the range.

families.name: Westcoast
families.description: The Westcoast chaise sofa features a soft polyester fabric that is durable and easy to maintain. Its versatile chaise section provides extra seating and comfort. The sofa’s neutral colors and clean design suit a variety of living spaces.

families.name: Island coffee table, stackable
families.description: The Island coffee table set includes two tables of different sizes with a harmonious, asymmetrical design. Warm finishes provide a natural look while the materials ensure durability and easy maintenance. The tables can be used stacked or separately for versatile placement.

families.name: Islet
families.description: The Islet round coffee table features a warm walnut surface and a sturdy MDF frame with a stable conical leg. Its compact size and natural wood look bring a calm and practical touch to living spaces. The table is easy to maintain and suits both classic and modern interiors.

families.name: Meta
families.description: The Meta coffee table family brings together pared-back shapes in a practical range of sizes for different living room layouts. Round and rectangular options make it easy to choose a table that suits the scale and arrangement of your seating area. Each design is offered in MDF, Wood veneer, with selected versions in Brown. The collection includes compact and longer formats, giving the Meta range a consistent look across multiple table proportions.

families.name: Metz
families.description: The Metz coffee tables bring a simple square profile to the living room, with a size that suits smaller seating areas or as a central table in a larger space. Each table measures 78 × 78 × 45 cm and is made from MDF, Oak, Wood veneer. The range is offered in Natural, Brown, and White Wash finishes, allowing you to choose a look that works with your room scheme while keeping the same clean, compact form.

families.name: Reef
families.description: The Reef coffee table features a simple, modern design with a warm finish that suits many interiors. Its compact size makes it practical for both small and larger spaces. Crafted from durable MDF and paper materials, it is easy to maintain and built for everyday use.

families.name: Tilda
families.description: Tilda coffee tables are designed for everyday living spaces and bring together a beige finish with metal and stone. The family includes a round coffee table and a matching end table, both shaped for use beside seating or as a focal point in a room. Their clean profile suits a range of interior settings, from relaxed to more composed arrangements. The combination of materials and the soft neutral colour gives the tables a calm, versatile presence.

families.name: Oak
families.description: This oak console table brings natural elegance to any space. Its warm oak surface and natural brown tone create a calm and harmonious atmosphere. The minimalist design adds lightness while providing a sturdy workspace. Two integrated drawers keep small items neatly stored, making it suitable for hallways, work areas or as a side table.

families.name: Moon Bronze continental bed
families.description: Choose a Moon Bronze continental bed in the size that suits your bedroom. The grey finish and wooden legs give the range a consistent appearance. Use the selected product's details to compare dimensions, construction and included components, and check the delivery and assembly arrangements with the retailer before ordering.

families.name: Moon Gold Continental Bed
families.description: Choose a Moon Gold continental bed by size, colour and comfort type. The range includes several widths and both 200 cm and 210 cm lengths. Available combinations differ: each colour and comfort type is offered in selected sizes. Check the exact bed's dimensions and included components, and choose any separate headboard or topper to match.

families.name: Moon Silver continental bed
families.description: The Moon Silver continental bed combines comfort and timeless style for the bedroom. It features a 5-zone pocket spring system that supports the body individually. The bed frame is made from durable wood and chipboard, complemented by high wooden legs that make cleaning simple. Optional headboards and mattress toppers are available to tailor the bed to your needs.

families.name: Cloud Corner Sofas
families.description: The Cloud corner sofa offers a modern and understated design with soft, rounded lines and a spacious seating area. Its beige polyester fabric is durable and easy to maintain, fitting well in contemporary living rooms or lounge areas.

families.name: Haave
families.description: The Haave corner sofa has a 293 × 241 cm footprint and comes in two orientations. Choose the left- or right-facing version using the product image and layout, then check access through doors, stairs and turning spaces. The beige finish is shared by both options; the exact construction and package details are listed on each product page.

families.name: Lugo
families.description: The Lugo corner sofa creates a welcoming and modern atmosphere. Its open corner design provides ample seating for relaxation and social moments. The sofa features a practical and airy layout with low armrests and backrests. Upholstered in breathable fabric, it is comfortable and durable for everyday use.

families.name: Westcoast
families.description: Choose a Westcoast corner sofa by size, orientation and colour. The range includes 245 × 200 cm, 295 × 200 cm and 313 × 200 cm layouts in beige, brown and grey. Compare the left- and right-facing product images with your room plan, and check the package dimensions as well as the assembled size before ordering.

families.name: Haley Decorative Cushion
families.description: Decorative cushions in Haley upholstery, available in 45 x 45 cm and 60 x 40 cm sizes.

families.name: Hike Decorative Cushion
families.description: Decorative cushions in Hike upholstery, available in 45 x 45 cm and 60 x 40 cm sizes.

families.name: Hix Decorative Cushion
families.description: Decorative cushions in Hix upholstery, available in 45 x 45 cm and 60 x 40 cm sizes.

families.name: Bow
families.description: The Bow dining chair combines a soft fabric seat with foam padding for comfort. Its metal frame and plywood construction provide stability and durability. It is easy to assemble and suits various interior styles.

families.name: Nicola
families.description: The Nicola dining chair features a slender oak frame and soft beige fabric upholstery. Its compact and rounded design fits well in various spaces, providing comfortable seating with low armrests that blend into the backrest. The chair suits Scandinavian interiors and is easy to maintain.

families.name: Metz
families.description: The Metz range includes fixed tables and extending models for rooms that need more flexibility. Choose a finish, then compare the table's dimensions and construction. Some extending models offer 120, 160 and 200 cm settings. Check the selected product for its exact measurements, extension arrangement and materials before matching it with your dining chairs.

families.name: Moon Bronze Divan Bed
families.description: The Moon Bronze divan bed offers balanced support with its 5-zone pocket spring system. Its frame is made from durable wood and it stands on smoked ash tapered legs that add lightness and ease of cleaning. Available in several sizes, it can be complemented with optional toppers and headboards to suit individual needs.

families.name: Moon Gold Divan Bed
families.description: The Moon Gold divan bed provides firm and balanced support with its 7-zone pocket spring system. Designed to support different sleeping positions, it promotes restful sleep. Upholstery is easy to maintain, complemented by sturdy tapered legs in black or smoked ash finishes.

families.name: Moon Silver divan bed
families.description: The Moon Silver divan range includes 80, 90, 120 and 140 cm widths, each with a 200 cm length. Grey upholstery gives the beds a consistent look across the different sizes. Check the selected bed's overall height, support system and included components, then match any separate topper or headboard to its dimensions.

families.name: Nest & Living Basic Duvet Set
families.description: Soft and lightweight duvet set for easy-care everyday bedroom use.

families.name: Nest & Living Bronze Duvet Set
families.description: Light duvet set with practical everyday comfort.

families.name: Nest & Living Silver Duvet
families.description: Duvets selected for everyday warmth, breathable fabrics, and practical bedroom use.

families.name: Staycation
families.description: The Staycation duvet family offers two white options for the bed, both made from Cotton, Polyester. Choose the size that suits your bedding setup: 200 × 150 × 5 cm for a smaller cover or 200 × 220 × 5 cm for a larger one. With a simple white finish, these duvets fit easily into a range of bedroom styles and pair well with different bedding looks. The family keeps the same material and colour across both sizes, while giving you a choice of dimensions for your preferred bed size.

families.name: Staycool Duvet
families.description: Cooling duvets from the Staycool series.

families.name: Wooly
families.description: The Wooly family offers a duvet in a clean White finish with a soft, understated look for everyday sleeping spaces. Its Cotton and Wool material combination gives the range a natural, familiar character that suits a calm bedroom setting. Sized at 150 × 200 × 1 cm, it is a practical choice for use on a single bed or as a lighter covering layer. The simple appearance makes it easy to pair with different bedding styles, whether kept minimal or layered with other textiles.

families.name: Haley Footstool
families.description: Compact upholstered footstool in Hevra fabric, available in selected neutral tones.

families.name: Lugo
families.description: Lugo footstool offers a practical extra seat or footrest with a compact design and rounded edges that create a soft, inviting look. Its sturdy frame combines solid wood and plywood with foam padding for comfort. The dense upholstery fabric is easy to maintain and durable, making Lugo a fitting addition to calm and harmonious living spaces.

families.name: Westcoast
families.description: The Westcoast footstool provides a comfortable extra seat or footrest with a soft, evenly shaped cushion. Its neutral colours and simple rectangular form blend well with different interiors. The metal legs add a light and subtle contrast. The polyester fabric is durable and easy to maintain.

families.name: Heaven
families.description: The Heaven 4-seater divan sofa features a reversible chaise to suit your space. It combines a supportive pocket spring seat with foam cushioning and a sturdy frame of wood, plywood, and metal. Low rectangular armrests and textured fabric upholstery create a calm and practical design that fits various interiors.

families.name: Nordic Pergolas
families.description: Plan an outdoor seating or dining area around a Nordic pergola. The range includes 300 × 300 cm and 392 × 300 cm footprints in beige and black. Construction and covering materials vary by model, so use the selected product's details when comparing them. Confirm the assembly, anchoring and weather-use instructions before choosing an installation location.

families.name: Moon Bronze
families.description: The Moon Bronze headboard features a smooth surface and comes in beige, grey, and anthracite fabric options. It is available in five widths to fit different bed sizes. The headboard is delivered assembled for easy installation.

families.name: Moon Gold Headboard
families.description: The Moon Gold headboard offers a calm and simple design with button accents arranged in five rows. It comes in beige, grey and anthracite fabric options and multiple widths to fit different bed sizes. The headboard is delivered assembled for easy placement.

families.name: Moon Silver
families.description: The Moon Silver headboard brings a calm and refined atmosphere to the bedroom while offering sturdy support for the bed. Its buttoned fabric surface is breathable and creates a sophisticated textured look. The padded lower edge protects the wall and adds comfort. Made with durable, high-quality fabric, the headboard maintains its shape and is easy to keep clean.

families.name: Nest & Living Mattress Protector
families.description: A quilted mattress protector designed to fit securely with elastic corners. It offers practical protection against dirt and wear. Machine washable at 60 degrees and fits standard washing machines.

families.name: Staycool Mattress Protector
families.description: Cooling mattress protectors from the Staycool series.

families.name: Staygentle Mattress Protector
families.description: Tencel mattress protectors from the Staygentle series.

families.name: Moon Gold Mattress
families.description: The Moon Gold mattress combines quality and versatility with two comfort options: a 7-zone pocket spring system for tailored support or memory foam that adapts to body contours. It comes in beige or anthracite and multiple sizes to suit different needs. Durable materials ensure easy care and lasting comfort.

families.name: Moon Silver mattress
families.description: The Moon Silver mattress features a 5-zone pocket spring system that provides tailored support for different body areas. It is designed to combine comfort, durability, and understated style. The mattress can be complemented with optional toppers to suit personal preferences and comes with a 4000-day quality guarantee.

families.name: Moon
families.description: The Moon fabric phone pocket offers a simple and practical storage solution for small electronics and accessories. Its compact, rectangular shape fits well beside beds or armchairs. Made from densely woven fabric, it is durable and easy to maintain.

families.name: Stavanger
families.description: The Stavanger family is designed for coffee table settings where a compact footprint and easy placement matter. Its Brown finish and the mix of Aluminium and Polyrattan create a clear, relaxed look suited to living spaces, lounges, or covered seating areas. With a 48 × 48 × 45 cm size, this table works well beside sofas and armchairs or as a central surface in smaller rooms. The Stavanger design keeps the focus on simple everyday use and a coordinated, understated appearance.

families.name: Haven
families.description: The Haven dining chair brings a calm and comfortable presence to outdoor dining areas. Crafted from natural colored polyrattan with beige cushions, it combines aluminium, fabric and polyrattan materials for lasting comfort and durability. Designed for summer use, it suits various outdoor spaces and is easy to maintain.

families.name: Messina
families.description: The Messina dining chair features a clean, modern design with a sturdy powder-coated aluminium frame and wide armrests for comfort. Its stackable form saves space and is practical for both indoor and outdoor use. The textline fabric is durable, water-repellent and quick-drying, making the chair suitable for terraces and balconies.

families.name: Saarni
families.description: The Saarni stackable dining chair features a light brown finish with a modern design suitable for both indoor and outdoor dining. Its aluminium frame is lightweight yet sturdy, complemented by nonwood surfaces that resemble natural wood without requiring special care. The chair’s stackable design allows for easy storage and handling.

families.name: Haven
families.description: The Haven dining table is a modern centrepiece for home or terrace dining. Its sturdy aluminium frame and polyrattan finish create a warm and inviting atmosphere. The glass surface is refined and easy to care for, offering generous space for shared meals.

families.name: Messina
families.description: The Messina dining table 220x100 cm invites relaxed outdoor moments with its natural toned top and sculpted legs. Its modern Scandinavian design fits well with garden and terrace furniture. The table offers ample space and durability for everyday use. The combination of EasyWood and aluminium ensures easy care and long-lasting performance.

families.name: Saarni
families.description: The Saarni range includes outdoor dining tables for different terrace and garden layouts. Aluminium frames and nonwood surfaces are paired with beige or brown tones across the available models. Check the selected table's dimensions and finish before matching chairs, and follow its outdoor care and storage instructions.

families.name: Haven
families.description: The Haven lounge chair blends natural materials with modern design. Made from durable polyrattan with beige cushions and a black frame, it provides a relaxed and understated seating option for outdoor spaces.

families.name: House Nordic Derby Outdoor Lounge Seating
families.description: Lounge chair with a natural teak frame and polyrattan seat and backrest, designed for comfort and versatile use indoors or outdoors.

families.name: Nordic Outdoor Lounge Seating
families.description: Modular outdoor lounge seating from the Nordic collection, including corner sections, middle sections, ottomans, and larger sofa configurations in white aluminium and beige fabric.

families.name: Haven
families.description: The Haven corner sofa set offers a calm and comfortable seating solution for outdoor spaces. It features a beige polyrattan frame with soft cushions and a high backrest for support. The set includes matching stools and a glass-topped table, creating a harmonious and practical arrangement for terraces or balconies.

families.name: Nordic Outdoor Lounge Set
families.description: Outdoor lounge set configurations from the Nordic collection with white aluminium frames, beige cushions, and selected layouts with integrated coffee tables.

families.name: Palazzo
families.description: The Palazzo outdoor sofa set creates a relaxed seating area suitable for gardens, terraces, or balconies. It includes a three-seat sofa, two armchairs, and two versatile tables. The set combines steel frames, textilene fabric, and foam cushions for durability and comfort. The light beige tones blend naturally with outdoor surroundings.

families.name: Nordic Outdoor Storage
families.description: Outdoor storage boxes from the Nordic collection with aluminium frames and weather-ready fabric-lined lids, available in two sizes and beige or black finishes.

families.name: House Nordic Derby Outdoor Sun Lounger
families.description: The House Nordic Derby sun lounger offers a blend of natural teak warmth and airy polyrattan comfort. Its adjustable backrest allows for personalized seating positions. The minimalist design fits well in both modern and classic outdoor settings.

families.name: Nest & Living Gold Pillow
families.description: Pillows designed for a fuller feel, including comfort and quilted options.

families.name: Nest & Living Silver Pillow
families.description: Pillows for everyday bedroom comfort, including classic and box pillow options.

families.name: Night
families.description: The Night pillow family brings a clean, straightforward look to the bedroom. Designed in white, it fits easily with a wide range of bedding styles and room settings. This pillow is sized at 60 × 50 × 15 cm and made from Cotton, Polyester. It suits the pillows category for use on a bed or as part of a layered bedding arrangement.

families.name: Staycation Pillow
families.description: Bedroom pillows from the Staycation series.

families.name: Staycomfort Pillow
families.description: Everyday pillows from the Staycomfort series.

families.name: Staycool Pillow
families.description: Cooling pillows and pillow protectors from the Staycool series.

families.name: Stayergo Classic
families.description: Stayergo Classic pillows are designed for everyday sleeping arrangements in a clean white finish. The compact 56 × 42 × 11 cm size suits beds where a smaller pillow format is preferred, while the cotton and polyester material combination keeps the look straightforward and easy to coordinate with different bedding styles. This pillow family keeps the presentation consistent and practical, with a classic profile that works well as part of a regular bedroom setup. Its simple appearance makes it suitable for use on its own or alongside other bedding items in the same space.

families.name: Stayergo Shape
families.description: The Stayergo Shape family brings together pillows designed in a compact rectangular form for everyday use in the bedroom. Their simple white look makes them easy to coordinate with a range of bedding styles. This pillow measures 50.5 × 34 × 10.5 cm and is made from Cotton and Polyester. It suits those looking for a shaped pillow format with a neat, understated appearance.

families.name: Wooly
families.description: The Wooly family brings a clean, understated look to pillow styling with a white finish and a classic rectangular profile. It works well as a calm base in bedrooms and can be paired easily with other soft furnishings. This pillow measures 60 × 50 × 12 cm and is made from Cotton, Wool. Its familiar shape and neutral colour make it an easy choice for beds, sofas or seating areas where a simple textile accent is wanted.

families.name: House Nordic Beckley Planter
families.description: The House Nordic Beckley planter set includes three brown terracotta pots in different sizes. Their rounded shapes and textured surfaces highlight the natural qualities of the clay. The set fits well in both indoor and outdoor spaces, bringing a calm and warm atmosphere.

families.name: Amaris
families.description: The Amaris rug features a refined pattern and a soft viscose pile that adds a subtle sheen and silk-like feel. Its blend of viscose and polyester creates a gentle contrast that highlights the classic ornament design. Available in two sizes, it suits both traditional and modern interiors.

families.name: Basalt
families.description: Use a Basalt rug to mark out a seating or dining area, or to add colour beside the bed. The multicolour design is available in more than one size. Compare the selected rug's measurements with the furniture layout, leaving enough space for chair movement and nearby doorways.

families.name: Bilbao
families.description: The Bilbao rug brings warmth and a vintage touch with its grey and blue-grey tones accented by soft pink and beige floral motifs. It is designed for daily use in busy spaces and is easy to clean, making it suitable for homes with children or pets.

families.name: Como
families.description: The Como rug family offers a calm, versatile look for interiors that need a defined floor area and a touch of colour. The green tone works well in living rooms, bedrooms, and other everyday spaces, while the rectangular shape makes it easy to place beneath furniture or in open areas. This rug is made from Cotton and Polyester and measures 160 × 230 × 2 cm, giving it a substantial presence without overwhelming the room. Its proportions suit a range of layouts, from seating zones to larger open-plan settings.

families.name: Desenzano
families.description: Desenzano rugs bring a calm, understated presence to interior spaces. The collection is suited to everyday settings where a rug can help define a seating area, soften a room, or add a finished look under furniture. This rug is presented in 160 × 230 × 2 cm and made from Cotton, Polyester. Its proportions make it suitable for larger areas where a rectangular rug can help structure the layout and complement a range of furnishings.

families.name: Dolomite
families.description: Choose a Dolomite rug to bring colour to a living room, dining area or bedroom. The range offers more than one size, so compare the selected rug with the footprint of your furniture. Check its materials and care instructions before choosing where to place it.

families.name: Dozza
families.description: The Dozza rug combines muted grey and light beige tones with a traditional oriental geometric pattern for a calm and understated look. It suits living rooms, bedrooms, and hallways, softening the space and enhancing comfort. Made from durable polypropylene, it is easy to maintain and suitable for everyday use.

families.name: Garda
families.description: The Garda range brings red tones to a cotton and polyester rug. Choose the size to suit your furniture arrangement, whether you are defining a seating area or adding a textile layer to the bedroom. Compare the exact measurements and follow the selected rug's care instructions.

families.name: Glint
families.description: The Glint rug family offers a multicolour finish in Chenillepolyester, bringing an easy way to define a room with colour and pattern. Its low 0.1 cm profile keeps the design visually light while fitting neatly into everyday living spaces. Choose 160 × 230 × 0.1 cm for smaller seating areas or 200 × 290 × 0.1 cm for larger spaces. Both sizes share the same multicolour look and material, making it simple to coordinate across different rooms.

families.name: Grant
families.description: Grant is a multicolour rug family designed for use in living spaces, dining areas or bedrooms. Its patterned look adds colour to the room, while the two size options make it easier to choose a fit for different layouts. Both rugs are made in Chenillepolyester and have a low profile. The smaller format suits more compact areas, while the larger one works well under a seating group or a dining table.

families.name: Lucca Rug
families.description: This oriental-style rug features a smooth surface that feels soft and pleasant underfoot while remaining durable. Its carefully selected plain or subtly patterned design elements create a calm and stylish atmosphere that fits many interior styles.

families.name: Lyra
families.description: The Lyra rug blends natural aesthetics with a soft, silk-like viscose pile and a durable wool base. Woven using a high and low technique, it features a subtle three-dimensional pattern in a harmonious colour palette. Available in two practical sizes, it suits living rooms, bedrooms, and other central spaces.

families.name: Moderni
families.description: These modern rugs feature graphic patterns that add subtle rhythm to your space. The soft surface feels comfortable underfoot, and the fringed edges complete the look. A non-slip backing keeps the rug in place during daily use. Made from a blend of cotton and polyester, they are water washable and easy to maintain.

families.name: Muse
families.description: Muse is a multicolour rug family in Chenillepolyester, designed to add a patterned focal point to living areas, bedrooms or other interior spaces. Its low 0.1 cm profile keeps the look close to the floor, while the two size options make it easy to choose the right scale for a room. The smaller format suits more compact areas or layered styling, while the larger format works well in spacious settings.

families.name: Ruutu
families.description: The Ruutu Rug offers a quiet, modern pattern that fits well in living rooms, bedrooms, or dining spaces. Made from a durable polyester and cotton blend, it has a matte texture and short fringes that add a subtle warmth to the room. Its design balances simplicity with a dynamic check pattern.

families.name: Saaga
families.description: The Saaga Rug combines modern graphic design with the refined texture of natural materials. Its viscose pile provides a silky softness and subtle sheen, while the wool base adds strength and support. The rug’s curved lines and subtle high and low technique create depth and a three-dimensional effect. Available in two practical sizes, it suits living rooms, bedrooms, or other central spaces.

families.name: Sevilla
families.description: The Sevilla rug offers a smooth surface that feels soft and comfortable underfoot while maintaining its durability. Its carefully selected solid colours or subtle patterns create a calm and elegant atmosphere that complements a variety of interior styles.

families.name: Sirmione
families.description: Choose a Sirmione rug in beige or green to suit the floor and surrounding furniture. The range includes several colour and size combinations. Open the selected rug to check its measurements, materials and care details, and allow room for doors and dining chairs to move over or around it.

families.name: Sway
families.description: The Sway rug family is designed in a multicolour palette and made from Chenillepolyester, giving each room a varied visual accent. Its low profile suits placement in living rooms, bedrooms, or other interior areas where a rug can help define a space. Choose between two sizes to match the scale of your room: 160 × 230 × 0.1 cm or 200 × 290 × 0.1 cm. Both versions share the same multicolour appearance and material, with the larger size offering broader floor coverage.

families.name: Yanam
families.description: The Yanam rug features a textured surface with a worn appearance and subtle multicolor shades that blend harmoniously. It suits both modern and bohemian interiors, adding a calm artistic touch. The soft surface feels pleasant underfoot, and the non-slip backing keeps it securely in place. Made of polyester and cotton, it is water washable and easy to maintain.

families.name: Bacoli
families.description: The Bacoli collection brings a clean, vertical presence to shelving and display. With a natural oak finish, it suits spaces that call for a simple, understated look while helping keep books, objects and tableware neatly arranged. This family is defined by its cabinet-style form and balanced proportions, making it suitable for living areas, dining spaces or hallways. The design focuses on everyday storage and display, with materials and dimensions chosen to support a composed, streamlined appearance.

families.name: Mystery
families.description: The Mystery Shelf creates a light and modern atmosphere with four wide shelves that hold books, decorations, or plants securely thanks to raised edges. Its black finish pairs with slender metal legs and oak veneer for a sculptural, Scandinavian look. Suitable for living rooms, home offices, or hallways, the shelf is stable and durable while maintaining an airy presence.

families.name: Swallow
families.description: The Swallow side table features a natural rubberwood surface with a warm tone and visible wood grain. Its round shape and compact size make it suitable for small spaces. The table is practical and easy to move, fitting well beside sofas or beds.

families.name: Bacoli
families.description: The Bacoli family is defined by a natural oak appearance and a clean sideboard profile suited to dining rooms, living areas, or hallways. It offers a straightforward way to store and organise everyday items while keeping the room visually calm. This range includes the Bacoli Sideboard at 180 × 45 × 70 cm. It is made from Particle board, MDF, Melamine, Plywood, and Wood veneer.

families.name: Meta
families.description: The Meta sideboard family offers a clean-lined storage piece for dining rooms, living rooms, or hallways. Each design measures 140 × 45 × 76 cm and uses MDF with wood veneer, creating a calm, straightforward look that suits everyday storage needs. The collection is available in a natural oak finish and a brown version, allowing you to choose the tone that best fits your interior.

families.name: Westcoast
families.description: The Westcoast neck support cushion adds gentle comfort to your sofa or armchair. It features a smooth polyester fabric that is durable and easy to care for. The cushion attaches simply behind the sofa backrest with a discreet metal rod, blending well with modern interiors.

families.name: Bacoli
families.description: The Bacoli storage cabinet line is designed for organised storage in a clean, natural oak style. Its enclosed form suits living rooms, dining areas, hallways, or other spaces where you want items kept out of sight while remaining close at hand. The family includes a four-door cabinet format that gives a substantial storage presence without adding unnecessary visual clutter. The cabinet measures 90 × 40 × 140 cm and is made from Particle board, MDF, Melamine, Plywood, Wood veneer. It combines a straightforward silhouette with a natural oak finish for an understated look that works easily with many interiors.

families.name: Meta
families.description: The Meta storage cabinet family combines a tall, slim profile with practical closed storage for rooms that need organisation without taking up much floor space. Both cabinets measure 100 × 40 × 118 cm and are made from MDF, Wood veneer. One version is finished in Brown, giving a darker look, while the other keeps a more natural appearance. Use them for storing tableware, books, office items, or other household essentials where a neat cabinet is preferred.

families.name: Bay
families.description: The Bay swivel armchair features soft fabric upholstery in a light beige tone and a black metal base that adds subtle contrast. Its rounded shape offers a comfortable seating experience while complementing both modern and classic interiors. A practical and understated choice for everyday relaxation.

families.name: Blow
families.description: The Blow swivel chair combines comfort with a modern design. It features a high backrest and wide armrests for support and relaxation. The swivel steel legs add practicality and a light appearance.

families.name: Breeze
families.description: Breeze provides a swivelling seat for a living room or reading corner. Choose beige, brown or grey to suit the surrounding furniture, then check the selected chair's dimensions and materials. Leave space around the chair for the swivel movement as well as room to walk past it.

families.name: Wind
families.description: The Wind swivel chair with ottoman combines a modern design with practical comfort. Upholstered in warm beige or light grey fabric, it features a high backrest for support and slender metal legs that add a light touch. The matching ottoman complements the chair for added seating or relaxation.

families.name: Freedom
families.description: The Freedom family is a range of three-seater sofas designed for living room seating. Its profile combines a generous format with a simple, contemporary expression, making it suitable for relaxed everyday use and larger lounge settings. This sofa is presented in white and measures 216 × 97 × 72 cm. It is made from fabric, metal, plywood, and polyester, giving it a material mix that supports its tailored, modern appearance.

families.name: Lugo
families.description: The Lugo sofa offers a calm and understated design suitable for everyday living. It features a sturdy frame made from solid wood, plywood, and chipboard, with soft foam cushions for comfort. The upholstery is smooth and designed to withstand daily use while being easy to maintain.

families.name: Sulo
families.description: The Sulo sofa combines modern Scandinavian design with practical comfort. It features a low backrest, soft seat cushions, and durable No-Zag springs with feather padding for lasting support. Its white corduroy upholstery adds a subtle texture suited to contemporary living spaces.

families.name: Voyage
families.description: The Voyage 3-seater sofa offers a wide and comfortable seat with a high backrest and soft cushions for lasting support. Its solid wood and plywood frame ensures stability, while the foam and feather padding add softness. The fabric upholstery is easy to care for and complements Scandinavian and modern interiors.

families.name: Westcoast
families.description: The Westcoast 3-seater sofa features a soft polyester fabric that is breathable and easy to maintain. Its clean lines and slender black metal legs create a calm and understated look suitable for various living spaces. The sofa offers comfortable seating with wide armrests and a straight backrest.

families.name: Moon Bronze topper
families.description: The Moon Bronze range offers a comfort foam topper in several widths, all with a 200 cm length and 5 cm thickness. Choose the width to match the mattress beneath it. The white finish is consistent across the range; consult the selected product and its care label for the cover and cleaning instructions.

families.name: Moon Gold Topper
families.description: Choose the comfort type and size to match your mattress. The Moon Gold range includes latex, comfort foam and memory foam toppers, with different thicknesses for each construction. Widths run from 80 cm to 200 cm, all with a 200 cm length. Each topper has a white finish; check the selected product for its thickness, materials and care details.

families.name: Moon Silver topper
families.description: Match a Moon Silver topper to your mattress with widths from 80 cm to 200 cm. Each listed option is 200 cm long and 5 cm thick. The comfort foam construction and white finish are shared across the range. Check the selected product's cover and care details before choosing bedding or washing the cover.

families.name: Bacoli
families.description: The Bacoli family is designed for TV storage in a natural oak look, combining a broad surface with a low, streamlined profile. It suits living room setups that call for a practical media base with a calm, understated appearance. This TV stand measures 200 × 45 × 55 cm and is made from Particle board, MDF, Melamine, Plywood, Wood veneer.

families.name: Meta
families.description: The Meta TV Stand family is designed as a lowboard for living room media storage and display. Both pieces measure 180 × 40 × 55.6 cm and are made from MDF, Wood veneer, giving the range a pared-back, natural material character. One version highlights a natural oak look, while the other brings a darker brown tone inspired by dark espresso oak. The shared proportions suit larger televisions and help create a balanced, horizontal presence in the room.
